summary.text: Steve Johnson, a Democrat, represents District 34A (Harford County) in the Maryland House of Delegates and is listed on the Health Committee.

paragraphs.text: Johnson was born in Garrison, Kentucky, on December 30, 1960, and attended Shady Spring High School in Shady Spring, West Virginia.
The legislature's biography lists service in the U.S. Army National Guard from 1977 to 1987 and a series of private-sector jobs, including United Parcel Service from 1990 to 2000.

It lists Johnson as owner of a rental property management company, Johnson Family Pharmacy and a commercial cleaning company, as Director of Economic Development for the City of Aberdeen from 2005 to 2017, and as a member of the Aberdeen Auxiliary Police since 2006.
